{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data to confirm the correct column names and types
print(penguins.columns)
print(penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dtypes)

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in body_mass_g:", penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Drop rows with missing values in either column
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print("Number of rows after dropping missing values:", len(penguins_clean))

# Compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print("Pearson correlation coefficient:", correlation)

# Return the correlation value
correlation"}
